description: How much rain fell over the last 24 hours (or up to 7 days) at the nearest working Environment Agency rain gauge, in millimetres, with the wettest 15 minutes and how complete the record is. Observed rainfall for gardeners, farmers, groundskeepers and anyone checking "how much rain did we get". Source: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API (tipping-bucket gauges). It measures one point, not your exact location, and is not a forecast. (cost: 1 credit)

dist_km.description: number, optional, search radius in km, 0.5-50, default 10

hours.description: integer, optional, hours to total back from now, 1-168, default 24

name: rainfall_last_24h
